Hapoel Ramat Gan Givatayim F.C. is an Israeli football club from Ramat Gan and Givatayim. They currently play in the Israeli Premier League, the first tier of Israeli football. Home matches are played at Ramat Gan Stadium, which has a capacity of 13,370. Their regular home strip is all-red.
